fee_notes: Year 1: no royalty. Years 2-5: 4% of Gross Revenues monthly. National Marketing Fee: $25/week (approx $108/mo), may increase to max 2% of Gross Revenues capped at $1,200/month. Regional Marketing Cooperative up to 2% of Gross Revenues or $1,200/month, whichever is less.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee: During the first year after signing the Franchise Agreement, no royalties will be required. During years 2-5, a royalty of 4% of Gross Revenues will be paid each month. National Marketing Fee: $25 per week; We reserve the right to increase the National Marketing Fee to not more than 2% of Gross Revenues, capped at $1,200 per month.
